museumCorroboration.facts: Hans Holbein the Younger; 1533; oil on wood (Baltic/Polish oak). The museum explains the measuring instruments and the skull revealed from an oblique viewpoint.

plate.bindingInterpretation: Measuring instruments and globes sit between two diplomats, while the distorted skull becomes legible only from another viewpoint. The console similarly changes the analytical lens through scenarios and review thresholds. This is an interpretive mechanics/concept binding, not museum metadata or a claim that the work depicts Thailand.
plate.reuseCheck: At addition: no other source-catalogue entry used this work; Hans Holbein the Younger had two plates including this one.

spatialMeasurement.requestedByParent: Measure only /foresight at 360 and 1440 against port 5501; merge only that route.
spatialMeasurement.timestampMeaning: Observed filesystem modification time of the actual driver output; the driver does not emit a measuredAt field.
spatialMeasurement.browserIdentityCheck: At both widths, route resolves to #foresight, heading is The Anchor Console, art/foresight.webp decodes, and document scrollWidth does not exceed innerWidth.
spatialMeasurement.limits: Explicitly partial two-width measurement. No full CSS-breakpoint sweep, independent MSH audit, enlarged-text pass or live deployment pass is claimed. Null firstAction values mean the probe did not identify an action, not that an action was proven absent. No chrome or measuredAt fields were fabricated to fit the stricter receipt helper.
